name: Role-specific manager, team and spectator workspaces
description: Checks that each share link opens only the relevant interface and spectators receive read-only match information.
steps: Create an event and open its private manager link
Register a team and open its private team link
Copy the public match-view link from event details
Open the public link in a fresh browser
expected: Manager sees only event controls, team sees its dashboard, and spectators see schedule and standings without private controls.

name: Team dashboard shows current registrations and previous event history
description: Verifies a linked squad can review its roster, active registrations, completed event results and archived history.
steps: Register a squad in an event and open its private team link
Open My Team and review the squad profile and current event
Complete the event and wait for its cleanup archive to be available
expected: The dashboard shows the squad profile, active events, and completed event records with kills, Booyahs and total points, including after the original event is removed.

name: Deleted event is absent from listings and stale links
description: Checks deletion is reflected after refresh and old private links do not display removed event data.
steps: Create an event and register a team
Delete it from Manager and confirm
Open the old manager and team links
expected: The deleted event is not listed and old private links show no event or team details.

name: Spectator match details and standings
description: Checks public viewers can inspect match information without manager or team credentials.
steps: Publish an event schedule and enter match results
Open it without organizer or team credentials
expected: The viewer sees schedule, match-wise and overall standings, with no room credentials or manager controls.
